name: cone join them into one mesh
prompt: Add a cube and a cone, join them into one mesh, and rename the result 'Blob'.

name: text object reading blender at origin
prompt: Add a text object reading "BLENDER" at the origin with extrude 0.1 and bevel depth 0.02, plus a ground plane scaled 4x4 at z=0 named Floor, and a point light at (3,3,4).

name: row unit x offset parent them
prompt: Build a row of 5 cubes with a 1.5 unit X offset, parent them to an empty named Train, and keyframe the empty's Z rotation at 0 degrees on frame 1 and 90 on frame 40.

name: sword lying along x blade x
prompt: Make a sword lying along X: blade cube 3 x 0.15 x 0.5 named SwordBlade at the origin, guard 0.3 x 0.6 x 0.6 at x -1.65, grip cylinder radius 0.1 depth 0.8 at x -2.2; parent all three to an empty named SwordRoot.

name: two one at x one at
prompt: Add two cubes, one at x=-2 and one at x=2, then join them into a single mesh called "Wall".
verify_note: no object for check: CubeL; no object for check: CubeR

name: grid rows columns cones spacing them
prompt: Make a grid of 3 rows and 4 columns of small cones with 1.5 spacing, give them all a red material with roughness 0.3.

name: camera at monkey at origin named
prompt: camera at (6,-6,4), a monkey at origin named Target, and an empty named Tracker at (0,-3,2) that tracks to the monkey

name: cylinder cone next to it then
prompt: make a cylinder, add a cone next to it, then join them into one mesh and put it in a collection called "Towers"

name: wide pure red material text label
prompt: Model a 1.5 wide cube with a pure red material and add a text label V1 beneath it at z -1.5 with 0.05 extrude.

name: set up studio area light at
prompt: Set up a small studio: area light at (4,4,6) with energy 300, a camera at (7,-7,4) looking at the origin, and a plane floor scaled 5x.

name: park bench two legs long flat
prompt: Build a simple park bench: two cube legs, a long flat seat cube, and a backrest cube tilted slightly, all parented under an empty called Bench_Root.

name: i want x grid cones spaced
prompt: I want a 3x3 grid of cones spaced 2 units apart, all with a deep blue material.

name: at child constraint targeting an empty
prompt: Make a cube at (0,0,1), add a CHILD_OF constraint targeting an empty named Root at the origin, then add a SCATTER geometry node setup on a plane floor at z=0.

name: parent three cones to an empty
prompt: parent three cones to an empty named Master at (2,0,1), display arrows, and put a point light at (2,0,4) energy 500

name: cone sphere then place both them
prompt: Add a cone and a sphere, then place both of them into a collection named 'Set'.

name: i need uv sphere subdivision surface
prompt: I need a uv sphere with a subdivision surface at levels 3, colored pure red with roughness 0.2, in a collection called "HeroParts".

name: just wall clock flat cylinder face
prompt: just make a wall clock: a flat cylinder face with two thin cylinder hands, and give the face a white material called ClockFace.

name: duplicate monkey named original three times
prompt: Duplicate a monkey named Original three times with an offset of (3,0,0) as linked copies, then apply a subsurf modifier with levels 2 to each.

name: set up street lamp tall cylinder
prompt: Set up a street lamp: a tall cylinder pole at x=0, a cone lamp head at z=5, and a point light at z=5 energy 100. Name the pole 'Pole' and give the head a yellow material named 'LampYellow'.

name: market stall x canopy at z
prompt: Build a market stall: a 2 x 1.2 canopy at z=2.2 on four 0.06-radius 2.2 m legs, plus a 2 x 1 counter at z=1. Name the canopy 'Canopy', the legs 'Leg', give it a red material 'Awning' and parent the legs to it.

name: put cone into new collection called
prompt: Put a cube and a cone into a new collection called Parts.

name: at uv sphere at join them
prompt: Add a cube at (-2,0,0) and a uv sphere at (2,0,0), join them into a single mesh named Blob, and put it in a collection called MergedParts.
verify_note: no object for check: PartA; no object for check: PartB

name: put cone at origin mirror it
prompt: Put a cone at the origin, mirror it across the X axis with a mirror modifier, and place both the cone and a new plane named "Floor" into a collection called "Stage".

name: assemble coffee mug exactly cylinder body
prompt: Assemble a coffee mug exactly: cylinder body radius 0.4 depth 1.0 at the origin, a torus handle radius 0.25 minor 0.06 on the right side at x 0.45, and a dark brown liquid circle inside at z 0.3. Name them MugBody, Handle, Coffee and parent everything to an empty Mug.

name: uv sphere then join them into
prompt: Add a cube and a uv sphere, then join them into one object called Blob.

name: light sun at w an area
prompt: light a scene with a sun at 400W and an area light at (-3,-3,4) at 150W, and place a camera with a 35mm lens at (0,-8,4).

name: fence post scaled at x duplicate
prompt: Build a fence: a cube post scaled 0.1 0.1 1 at x -2, duplicate it 5 times with a 0.8 offset along x, then add a sun light and a camera.

name: lay out row five uv spheres
prompt: Lay out a row of five uv spheres spaced 2 units apart along X and shade them all smooth.

name: cone named nose an empty at
prompt: make a cone named Nose, add an empty at 0,0,3 and parent the cone to it, then rename the empty Rig

name: put text label blender at extrude
prompt: Put a text label "Blender 5.2" at (0,-3,0.5) with extrude 0.05, a monkey at origin, and hide the text from render only.

name: grid rows columns spheres units apart
prompt: Add a grid of 4 rows and 5 columns of small spheres, 1.5 units apart, sitting on a plane floor, all with a glossy blue material roughness 0.1.

name: low poly tree trunk green canopy
prompt: Make a low-poly tree with a brown trunk and a green canopy.

name: playground slide swing set sandbox
prompt: Build a playground scene with a slide, a swing set, and a sandbox.

name: three put them all into collection
prompt: make three cubes and put them all into a collection named Props

name: put camera at looking at origin
prompt: put a camera at 7,-7,5 looking at the origin with a 50mm lens, and put 3 ico spheres in a new collection named "props" at 0,2,0 and 0,4,0 and 0,6,0

name: please red uv sphere named ball
prompt: please build a small scene with a red uv_sphere named Ball at (0,0,1), a green cube named Crate at (2,0,1), and a blue cylinder named Pillar at (-2,0,1), all sitting on a grey plane floor at z=0

name: robot character named buddy an ico
prompt: Build a robot character named "Buddy": an ico_sphere head radius 0.5 on a cylinder torso, two sphere shoulders, two cylinder arms, two cylinder legs, and two small uv_sphere eyes. Name every part, parent them all to an empty "Buddy" at the origin, and use two materials alternating over all meshes: "Metal" 0.4 0.4 0.45 and "Accent" 0.9 0.3 0.1.

name: create ring ring radius named post
prompt: Create a ring of 8 cubes of ring radius 3 named Post, plus a torus named Rail at the origin, all inside a collection called Fence.

name: sun light energy camera at text
prompt: add a SUN light with energy 3, a camera at (0, -6, 3), and a text object 'STUDIO' at (0, 0, 2)

name: an ico sphere set its material
prompt: Make an ico_sphere, set its material color to a bright red [1, 0.1, 0.1] with roughness 0.5, then put it in a new collection called HeroPieces.

name: create an empty named rigroot at
prompt: create an empty named RigRoot at (0,0,2), then build three cones under it at x=-2, 0, 2 all parented to RigRoot.

name: create two at x x join
prompt: Create two cubes at x -2 and x 2, join them into one object named TwinCubes, and put it in a collection called Pair.

name: could you bed headboard four legs
prompt: Could you build a simple bed with a headboard and four legs? Name it Bed.

name: create ring ico spheres ring radius
prompt: Create a ring of 8 ico spheres, ring radius 4, name them "Node", put them all in a collection called "Orbit", and add a torus at the center.

name: three row x offset name them
prompt: Add three cubes in a row with x offset 3, name them RowA_1, RowA_2, RowA_3, and put them all in a new collection called 'RowCubes'.

name: linked duplicates spaced units apart along
prompt: Make 6 linked duplicates of a cube spaced 2 units apart along X, set them to wireframe display, and give every other one a red material named2 blue.

name: scatter uv spheres x grid per
prompt: Scatter 9 UV spheres in a 3x3 grid, 3 per row spaced 2.5 and 3 rows spaced 2.5, all sharing one green (0,1,0) material with roughness 0.8.

name: snowman three stacked spheres carrot nose
prompt: a snowman with three stacked spheres, a carrot nose and a top hat

name: please plane at origin it material
prompt: Please make a plane at the origin, give it a material named GrassGreen with colour 0.1, 0.6, 0.2, and put it in a collection called GroundPieces.

name: set up three point lighting key
prompt: Set up three-point lighting: a key SUN at 1000W, a fill POINT at 300W at (4,2,3), and a rim SPOT at 500W behind at (-3,-4,2), plus a camera at (7,-7,4) looking at the origin.

name: brick named brick red material duplicated
prompt: Make a brick: cube named Brick with a red material 1 0 0, duplicated linked with offset 0,0,1.2, all inside a collection called Stack.

name: two named b put both them
prompt: Make two cubes named A and B and put both of them in a new collection called Props.

name: join two cylinders into one mesh
prompt: join two cylinders into one mesh and rename it Barrel, keep it at the origin

prompt: make a simple wooden chair with four legs

name: create three move them into collection
prompt: Create three cubes and move them into a collection called 'Props'.

name: snowman out three stacked spheres cone
prompt: build a snowman out of three stacked spheres with a small cone carrot nose and two tiny sphere eyes.

name: uv sphere cylinder join them into
prompt: Make a uv_sphere and a cylinder, join them into a single mesh named "Lollipop", then set its material color to bright red 1,0,0.

name: could you join cylinder together into
prompt: Could you join a cube and a cylinder together into a single mesh called Base?

name: put three spheres named collection called
prompt: Put three spheres named A1, A2 and A3 in a collection called Spheres, and two cubes named B1 and B2 in a collection called Blocks.

name: house base units wide cone roof
prompt: Make a simple house from a cube base 4 units wide and a cone roof, with a red material named RoofRed on the cone and a door cube on the front face, parented to an empty called HouseBase.
